Rules: the shared runtime is story-agnostic (no runtime code may name 1C, 2A, the freight terminal, prisoner numbers or any fact id of the continuity-initiative story); facts are the sole mutable truth; no new billed or live model calls; unit tests are hermetic.

GOAL (step 7b, runtime + the minimum package edit, three parts):

PART 1 - Fact-keyed entry text variants. Today scene entry text is the static SceneMetadata.entry_text (storygame/story_package/models.py), emitted in three places in storygame/runtime/engine.py (the opening around line 211, _apply_authored_transition around line 1076, the handoff path around line 1486) and read in storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py (around lines 1244 and 1491). Add an optional, package-declared set of entry variants to scene metadata: each variant has a list of required fact ids (all must be true) and a text; when the scene is entered, the base entry_text is emitted and then the text of every variant whose facts are all true, in declaration order. Put the selection in ONE helper used by every entry site, evaluated against the facts at the moment of entry. Loader validation (storygame/story_package/loader.py, reject with StoryPackageError, one test each): unknown fact id; empty requires; blank text; and player-visible hygiene the loader already applies to entry_text (follow how entry_text is checked, around loader.py line 691) must also cover variant text. Then author two variants on scene 2A in data/stories/continuity-initiative (plot.md frontmatter is where scene metadata lives): one requiring processing_numbers_copied (Kristin holds the copied prisoner numbers but still needs a way in) and one requiring service_level_access_known (they know the service approach but have weaker proof). Each is 1-2 plain sentences at 12th grade level (docs/narrator-writing-guide.md), names only things already declared and placed, and reveals nothing protected (JANUS, Brandon's development role, Kristin as bait, Michelle's resistance or location). If both facts are true both variants show; if neither, entry text is unchanged byte for byte.

PART 2 - Free-text wiring of follow_connection. RuntimeEngine.follow_connection(destination_id) (engine.py around line 246) is provider-free but nothing calls it from player text. Wire it: in RuntimeEngine.turn, after reference resolution and before the provider is called, if the player's command is a plain movement command (see docs/player-input-guide.md for the imperative forms, e.g. 'Go to the service level', 'Take the service entrance to the service level') whose target unambiguously names the destination place (by its declared name or id words) or the via entity of exactly one connection that departs from the protagonist's current place (containment-aware, as resolve_traversal already is), call follow_connection and return its result with no provider call. A command that names no such connection, names an unrelated entity, or is ambiguous falls through to the existing provider path unchanged. A refused traversal (access closed) must change nothing and must not burn the incident window; decide whether it should fall through to the provider or return the refusal and record the reasoning in the notes; prefer the choice that keeps the player's turn from being swallowed with no reply. Put the matching in a pure function in storygame/runtime/traversal.py next to resolve_traversal so it is unit-testable. No LLM-based matching and no regex over narrated prose.

PART 3 - Shared post-turn helper. follow_connection duplicates about 20 lines of the post-turn sequence at the end of _turn_active (record turn, advance pacing, activate pacing, canonical route events, authored transition, unresolved-incident check and resolution deadline backstop, then finish). Extract ONE private helper used by both without changing _turn_active behaviour (the staged-cue block that follows stays where it is unless it falls naturally into the helper). All existing tests must pass unchanged for this part.

TESTS (add; no billed model, no live worker): tests/test_entry_variants.py (loader rejects each invalid case on a synthetic package; the unrelated lighthouse fixture or a small synthetic package shows variants emitted in order, none emitted when facts are false; base text is byte-identical when no variant applies); tests for the 2A variants on the real package (1C->2A with processing_numbers_copied, with service_level_access_known, with both, with neither - use the journey helpers the step 7a test tests/test_scene_2a_advantages.py uses); tests/test_traversal.py additions or a new tests/test_traversal_text.py for the matching function and for turn() calling follow_connection with a scripted provider that records it was NOT called, plus fall-through cases (unrelated entity, ambiguous, closed access). Update any test that pinned 2A entry bytes only when the change is the intended variant, and say so in the notes.

OWNED FILES: storygame/**, data/stories/continuity-initiative/*, tests/*. Nothing else. Do not touch discovery cue or cue-lifecycle code (that is step 7c) beyond what Part 3 requires.

HOW TO RUN: first confirm PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)" prints a path inside the cwd. Focused: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov -n auto <files>. FULL suite (must end green): same command with no file args (bare pytest, NOT with '.'). Ruff on Python files you touch: PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix <files>, then -m ruff format <files>. Do not run uv.

NOTES CONTRACT: step7b-notes.md with sections: ENTRY VARIANTS (schema, helper, loader checks), TRAVERSAL WIRING (matching rule, refusal decision and reasoning), HELPER EXTRACTION, PACKAGE CHANGES, TESTS ADDED, OPEN QUESTIONS (or 'none'). Reply with a short summary.
